title: wardrik.subagent.failed
description: A subagent failed, with what it did and cost before it did: its events stay out of the log, so these are the whole of it.

tool_calls.description: How many tool calls it made.

usage.description: The tokens its model calls read and wrote, together.

cost.description: What its model calls and tools cost, together, which counts as the calling tool's; null where nothing priced them.
